summary: Guard urlsplit in pricing local check
pull_request_body: Guard the urlsplit call in _is_single_server_local against ValueError. When a spend ledger row holds a served_by value that urlsplit cannot parse, such as http://[::1, the devops ai cost report command crashes with an unhandled ValueError. New rows cannot hold such a value because extract_served_by refuses it, but legacy rows from before that change can. This change wraps the urlsplit call in a try-except ValueError. When urlsplit raises, the function returns False, treating the server as not local. The report then shows the row and the backend as unknown, instead of exiting with a traceback. The pattern of catching ValueError around a parse call is already established in _is_local_host in the same file. No new dependency is added.
why: Issue #2462 reports that devops ai cost report exits 1 with ValueError: Invalid IPv6 URL when a spend ledger row holds a served_by value such as http://[::1. The function _is_single_server_local in src/devops_cli/ai/spend/pricing.py calls urlsplit(clean) with no guard. Legacy rows from before the extract_served_by write-time guard can hold such a value. The report must show the row and treat the backend as unknown instead of crashing.
what_changes: Wrap the urlsplit(clean) call in _is_single_server_local with a try-except ValueError that returns False on exception.
Add a test that verifies _is_single_server_local returns False for http://[::1 without raising.
Add a test that verifies is_local returns False for a served_by value that urlsplit cannot parse.
Add a test that verifies a valid local served_by value such as http://localhost:11434 still resolves as local.
feasibility: The context shows _is_single_server_local at src/devops_cli/ai/spend/pricing.py line 243 calling urlsplit(clean) with no guard, matching the traceback in the issue.
The context shows _is_local_host in the same file catching ValueError from ipaddress.ip_address, confirming the try-except pattern is established in this module.
The context shows extract_served_by at src/devops_cli/ai/client/network.py line 99, confirming the write-time guard that prevents new rows from holding bad values.
The archived design at openspec/changes/archive/2026-10-28-1110-reply-server-origin/design.md confirms the legacy row scenario and references #2462.
First check: run uv run pytest tests/test_pricing.py -k unparseable -x to confirm the new test fails before the fix.
Second check: run uv run pytest tests/test_pricing.py -x to confirm all pricing tests pass after the fix.
existing_tool: No external tool covers this need. The fix is a try-except ValueError guard around one urlsplit call in src/devops_cli/ai/spend/pricing.py, plus tests. The written cost is roughly 5 lines of code and 20 lines of test. No new dependency is added. No internal code is deleted.

added.name: Report does not crash on unparseable served_by
added.text: The report command SHALL NOT raise an unhandled ValueError when a ledger row holds a served_by value that urlsplit cannot parse.

scenarios.name: Ledger row with unparseable served_by
scenarios.when: A spend ledger row has served_by set to http://[::1 and the user runs devops ai cost report --by backend
scenarios.then: The command exits 0 and prints the report table without a traceback

added.name: Unparseable backend shows as unknown
added.text: The report SHALL display the serving backend as unknown for a row whose served_by value urlsplit cannot parse.

scenarios.name: Backend column for unparseable value
scenarios.when: The report renders a row whose served_by is http://[::1
scenarios.then: The backend column for that row shows unknown

added.name: Valid served_by values still resolve
added.text: The report SHALL resolve a valid served_by value to its local or hosted classification as before.

scenarios.name: Valid local backend still detected
scenarios.when: A ledger row has served_by set to http://localhost:11434 and the user runs devops ai cost report --by backend
scenarios.then: The row is classified as local and the backend column shows the resolved value

groups.title: Guard urlsplit in _is_single_server_local and add tests
groups.test: Write a test that calls _is_single_server_local with the string http://[::1 and a _SettingsOnce instance, and asserts it returns False without raising ValueError. Write a test that calls is_local with served_by set to http://[::1 and asserts it returns False. Write a test that calls is_local with served_by set to http://localhost:11434 and asserts it returns True
groups.implementation: In _is_single_server_local, split the existing if clean in CONST_LOCAL_TRANSPORT_LABELS or urlsplit(clean).scheme == "http+unix" line into two checks. Keep the CONST_LOCAL_TRANSPORT_LABELS check as-is. Wrap the urlsplit(clean).scheme == "http+unix" check in a try block that catches ValueError and returns False
